# Reproducibility scope

This notebook reproduces the analysis workflow for critically ill patients with acute stroke using MIMIC-IV version 3.1 and eICU-CRD version 2.0. It covers the 24-hour landmark analysis, the 0–6-hour sensitivity analysis, model development, external validation, calibration, decision-curve analysis, SHAP summaries, baseline characteristics, subgroup performance, and fixed-threshold metrics.

The notebook reads only user-authorized CSV exports. It does not connect to or modify a database. No patient-level data, model objects, or result files are included in the public code release.

# 1. Portable setup

Run this notebook from the repository root or open it from the `notebooks` directory. The code discovers the repository from the working directory and uses environment variables only when you need a different data or results location.

```{r setup}
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

candidate_dirs <- unique(normalizePath(
    c(getwd(), file.path(getwd(), "..")), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE
))
repo_hits <- candidate_dirs[
    file.exists(file.path(candidate_dirs, "R", "run_stroke_models.R"))
]
if (length(repo_hits) == 0L) {
    stop("Repository root not found. Set the working directory to the code-release root.")
}
repo_dir <- repo_hits[[1L]]

data_dir <- Sys.getenv("STROKE_DATA_DIR", unset = file.path(repo_dir, "data"))
results_root <- Sys.getenv("STROKE_RESULTS_ROOT", unset = file.path(repo_dir, "results"))
model_dir <- file.path(results_root, "model_results")
validation_dir <- file.path(results_root, "validation")
publication_dir <- file.path(results_root, "publication")

mimic_csv <- Sys.getenv(
    "STROKE_MIMIC_CSV", unset = file.path(data_dir, "mimic_analysis.csv")
)
eicu_csv <- Sys.getenv(
    "STROKE_EICU_CSV", unset = file.path(data_dir, "eicu_analysis.csv")
)

if (!all(file.exists(c(mimic_csv, eicu_csv)))) {
    stop(
        "Input CSV files were not found. Export the SQL results to:\n",
        file.path(data_dir, "mimic_analysis.csv"), "\n",
        file.path(data_dir, "eicu_analysis.csv")
    )
}

required_packages <- c("tidymodels", "xgboost", "glmnet", "ranger")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
    !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
    stop(
        "Missing R packages: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
        ". Install them before running the notebook."
    )
}

model_script <- file.path(repo_dir, "R", "run_stroke_models.R")
validation_script <- file.path(repo_dir, "R", "run_stroke_validation.R")
report_script <- file.path(repo_dir, "R", "build_publication_report.R")
baseline_script <- file.path(repo_dir, "R", "build_baseline_flow.R")
subgroup_script <- file.path(repo_dir, "R", "build_subgroup_threshold.R")

dir.create(results_root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(validation_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(publication_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

Sys.setenv(
    STROKE_MIMIC_CSV = mimic_csv,
    STROKE_EICU_CSV = eicu_csv,
    STROKE_OUTPUT_DIR = model_dir,
    STROKE_RESULTS_DIR = model_dir,
    STROKE_PUBLICATION_DIR = publication_dir,
    STROKE_PROJECT_DIR = repo_dir,
    STROKE_R_LIBRARY = Sys.getenv("STROKE_R_LIBRARY", unset = ""),
    STROKE_TUNING_GRID_SIZE = Sys.getenv("STROKE_TUNING_GRID_SIZE", unset = "5")
)

cat("Repository:", repo_dir, "\n")
cat("MIMIC input:", mimic_csv, "\n")
cat("eICU input:", eicu_csv, "\n")
cat("Results root:", results_root, "\n")
```

# 2. Model development and external validation

The primary analysis uses the 24-hour landmark cohort. The 0–6-hour analysis is retained as a sensitivity analysis. Models are developed in MIMIC-IV and fixed for external validation in eICU-CRD.

```{r run-models, cache=TRUE}
expected_model_files <- file.path(model_dir, c(
    "model_metrics_landmark.csv", "model_metrics_early.csv",
    "predictions_landmark.csv", "predictions_early.csv",
    "model_landmark_xgboost_mimic_full.rds",
    "model_early_xgboost_mimic_full.rds"
))
if (all(file.exists(expected_model_files))) {
    cat("Existing model outputs detected; no refit was performed.\n")
} else {
    source(model_script, local = TRUE)
}
```

```{r show-model-metrics}
for (f in file.path(model_dir, c("model_metrics_landmark.csv", "model_metrics_early.csv"))) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
        cat("\n### ", basename(f), "\n", sep = "")
        print(utils::read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE))
    }
}
```

# 3. Publication-grade validation and figures

This section calculates patient-level bootstrap intervals, ROC and precision–recall curves, calibration summaries, decision-curve data, and SHAP summaries. The default is 1,000 bootstrap repetitions.

```{r validation, cache=TRUE}
bootstrap_reps <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(
    Sys.getenv("STROKE_BOOTSTRAP_REPS", unset = "1000")
))
if (is.na(bootstrap_reps) || bootstrap_reps < 100L) bootstrap_reps <- 1000L

source(validation_script, local = TRUE)
validation_result <- run_stroke_validation(
    results_dir = model_dir,
    validation_dir = validation_dir,
    bootstrap_reps = bootstrap_reps
)
```

```{r validation-summary}
bootstrap_file <- file.path(validation_dir, "bootstrap_metric_ci.csv")
if (file.exists(bootstrap_file)) {
    validation_summary <- utils::read.csv(bootstrap_file, check.names = FALSE)
    print(subset(validation_summary, dataset == "eICU_external_validation"))
}
```

```{r validation-figures, out.width="100%"}
figure_files <- file.path(validation_dir, c(
    "roc_external.png", "pr_external.png", "calibration_external.png",
    "dca_external.png", "shap_top20_landmark_xgboost.png",
    "shap_top20_early_xgboost.png"
))
figure_files <- figure_files[file.exists(figure_files)]
if (length(figure_files) > 0L) knitr::include_graphics(figure_files)
```

```{r publication-summary}
for (f in file.path(publication_dir, c(
```

# 5. Prespecified sensitivity analyses

Sensitivity analyses refit XGBoost in MIMIC and evaluate the fixed model in eICU. They are intentionally not run automatically when knitting this notebook because they may take substantial time.

```{r sensitivity-command, eval=FALSE}
system2(
    "Rscript",
    c(
        file.path("R", "run_stroke_sensitivity.R"),
        shQuote(mimic_csv), shQuote(eicu_csv),
        shQuote(file.path(results_root, "sensitivity"))
    )
)
system2(
    "Rscript",
    c(
        file.path("R", "run_sensitivity_validation.R"),
        shQuote(file.path(results_root, "sensitivity"))
    )
)
Sys.setenv(
    STROKE_PROJECT_DIR = repo_dir,
    STROKE_VALIDATION_DIR = validation_dir,
    STROKE_SENSITIVITY_DIR = file.path(results_root, "sensitivity")
)
source(file.path("R", "build_sensitivity_report.R"), local = TRUE)
```

# 6. Reproducibility notes

- The SQL files are read-only extraction queries and should be run only against the corresponding credentialed database schema.
- The 24-hour model uses `landmark_24h_eligible = 1` and `death_24h_to_30d_inhospital`.
- The 0–6-hour sensitivity model uses `death_30d_inhospital`.
- Patient-level identifiers are used only for grouped splitting and bootstrap resampling; they are not model predictors.
- Never commit the contents of `data/` or `results/` to a public repository.
